# Satyam Rai | AI Agent Developer and Microsoft Copilot Studio Consultant

> Satyam Rai is based in Gurugram, India. He works at Hollister Incorporated as an RPA Developer II / AI Agent Developer and has 5+ years of experience across IT and automation. He is open to freelance and remote work.

## Selected work

- [GISP Assistant — Global Inventory and Supply Planning](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#gisp-assistant) gives planners a Copilot Studio interface to a Microsoft Fabric data agent built on the global supply chain report’s Power BI semantic models. It supports questions about backorders, inventory across countries, planned production and capacity.
- [Fit for Growth Requirements & Traceability Assistant](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#ffg-assistant) helps SAP S/4HANA project teams trace requirements to test cases and defects. It uses an Excel export for coverage reports and Azure DevOps MCP for read-only checks of individual work items.
- [IBPedia](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#ibpedia) filters incoming SAP IBP emails for relevance and duplicates, then writes structured questions and answers to an Excel knowledge base.
- [HR and IT support agent](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#hr-it-agent) integrates Copilot Studio, Microsoft Teams and Graph API for ticket management. The project reduced support resolution time by 50%.
- [Invoice automation](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#invoice-automation) uses Azure AI Document Intelligence and Power Automate to extract data from 500+ invoices per week at 95% accuracy.
- [Marketing insights](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#marketing-insights) turns Salesforce and Chatter notes into Power BI insights. Analysis time fell from 120–240 minutes to about 10 minutes.
- [Full project portfolio](https://satyam-rai-1998.github.io/portfolio/#projects) includes résumé parsing, business card extraction and HR workflow automation.
